name: Heartswood Core
summary: Beneath Stormwind, warlocks use the Heartswood Core to summon a succubus. Gakin the Darkbinder provides the enchanted focus, made from an ancient tree’s wood, to open a passage to the Twisting Nether.

sections.title: A Focus for the Nether
sections.body: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter, warlocks perform rites beyond the city watch’s gaze. The Heartswood Core channels the magic that begins a binding ritual. Made from an ancient tree’s wood, it holds enough lingering power to pierce the veil between worlds. At a consecrated summoning circle, an initiate focuses dark arts through the core and opens a passage to the Twisting Nether. A succubus crosses the divide.

sections.title: The Trial of Binding
sections.body: A warlock who summons a demon must prove dominance over its cunning and seductive nature before controlling it. Gakin gives the Heartswood Core to promising practitioners so they can face the summoned demon in combat. Succubi prey on weakness and can overwhelm feeble minds. The encounter is a deadly rite of passage. The aspiring warlock must subdue the fiend and return the spent core to Gakin, proving a will strong enough to bind the servant permanently.

faq.q: What is the Heartswood Core used for?
faq.answer: Warlocks use the Heartswood Core at the summoning circle beneath the Slaughtered Lamb to open a passage to the Twisting Nether. A succubus crosses into our realm, and you must fight and bind it.

aliases: where do i get heartswood core
faq.answer: Gakin the Darkbinder provides the Heartswood Core. He is a master warlock who trains novices in the hidden catacombs beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Where must the core be used?
faq.answer: Use the Heartswood Core at the summoning circle in the crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, deep below Stormwind’s streets.

faq.q: What happens after the ritual is finished?
aliases: what do i do after summoning
faq.answer: After you summon the succubus, defeat it in combat and send it back to the void. Then return the Heartswood Core to Gakin the Darkbinder to learn how to command the demon at will.

angles.text: As an Alliance warlock, you use the Heartswood Core to summon and master your first succubus during training.
